CommunityApplications.Profile: Unraid templates for Mnema Talk, a small self-hosted home for one community (text channels, drop-in voice Talks and screen sharing), for SeaweedFS-Mnema, its private S3 media store, and for Mnemo, its self-hosted AI helper bot. Maintained by the Mnema project. Mnema Talk needs PostgreSQL 18 (the postgresql18 app from jj9987) and SeaweedFS-Mnema, installed first. Support questions go to the GitHub issues of mnema-xyz/talk and mnema-xyz/talk-mnemo-bot.
